paragraphs.text: 1. VERILY wondrous is the tender Youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his Mothers' milk.
paragraphs.original: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावप्येति धातवे ।
paragraphs.translit: citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvapyeti dhātave |

paragraphs.text: As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his great errand, suddenly grew strong.
paragraphs.original: अनूधा यदि जीजनदधा च नु ववक्ष सद्यो महि दूत्यं चरन्
paragraphs.translit: anūdhā yadi jījanadadhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyo mahi dūtyaṃ caran

paragraphs.text: 2. Then Agni was his name, most active to bestow, gathering up the trees with his consuming tooth;
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्ह नाम धायि दन्नपस्तमः सं यो वना युवते भस्मना दता ।
paragraphs.translit: agnirha nāma dhāyi dannapastamaḥ saṃ yo vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā |

paragraphs.text: Skilled in fair sacrifice, armed with destroying tongue, impetuous as a bull that snorteth in the mead.
paragraphs.original: अभिप्रमुरा जुह्वा स्वध्वर इनो न प्रोथमानो यवसे वृषा
paragraphs.translit: abhipramurā juhvā svadhvara ino na prothamāno yavase vṛṣā

paragraphs.text: 3. Praise him, your God who, bird-like, rests upon a tree, scattering drops of juice and pouring forth his flood,
paragraphs.original: तं वो विं न द्रुषदं देवमन्धस इन्दुं प्रोथन्तं प्रवपन्तमर्णवम् ।
paragraphs.translit: taṃ vo viṃ na druṣadaṃ devamandhasa induṃ prothantaṃ pravapantamarṇavam |

paragraphs.text: Speaking aloud with flame as with his lips a priest, and broadening his paths like one of high command.
paragraphs.original: आसा वह्निं न शोचिषा विरप्शिनं महिव्रतं न सरजन्तमध्वनः
paragraphs.translit: āsā vahniṃ na śociṣā virapśinaṃ mahivrataṃ na sarajantamadhvanaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Thou Everlasting, whom, far-striding fain to burn, the winds, uninterrupted, never overcome,
paragraphs.original: वि यस्य ते ज्रयसानस्याजर धक्षोर्न वाताः परि सन्त्यच्युताः ।
paragraphs.translit: vi yasya te jrayasānasyājara dhakṣorna vātāḥ pari santyacyutāḥ |

paragraphs.text: They have approached, as warriors eager for the fight, heroic Trita, guiding him to gain his wish.
paragraphs.original: आ रण्वासो युयुधयो न सत्वनं त्रितं नशन्त प्र शिषन्त इष्टये
paragraphs.translit: ā raṇvāso yuyudhayo na satvanaṃ tritaṃ naśanta pra śiṣanta iṣṭaye

paragraphs.text: 5. This Agni is the best of Kanvas, Kanvas' Friend, Conqueror of the foe whether afar or near.
paragraphs.original: स इदग्निः कण्वतमः कण्वसखार्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa idagniḥ kaṇvatamaḥ kaṇvasakhāryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Agni guard the singers, guard the princes well: may Agni grant to us our princes' gracious help.
paragraphs.original: अग्निः पातु गृणतो अग्निः सूरीनग्निर्ददातु तेषामवो नः
paragraphs.translit: agniḥ pātu gṛṇato agniḥ sūrīnagnirdadātu teṣāmavo naḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Do thou, Supitrya, swiftly following, make thyself the lord of Jatavedas, mightiest of all,
paragraphs.original: वाजिन्तमाय सह्यसे सुपित्र्य तृषु च्यवानो अनु जातवेदसे ।
paragraphs.translit: vājintamāya sahyase supitrya tṛṣu cyavāno anu jātavedase |

paragraphs.text: Who surely gives a boon even in thirsty land most powerful, prepared to aid us in the wilds.
paragraphs.original: अनुद्रे चिद्यो धृषता वरं सते महिन्तमाय धन्वनेदविष्यते
paragraphs.translit: anudre cidyo dhṛṣatā varaṃ sate mahintamāya dhanvanedaviṣyate

paragraphs.text: 7. Thus noble Agni with princes and mortal men is lauded, excellent for conquering strength with chiefs,
paragraphs.original: एवाग्निर्मर्तैः सह सूरिभिर्वसु ष्टवे सहसः सूनरो नृभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: evāgnirmartaiḥ saha sūribhirvasu ṣṭave sahasaḥ sūnaro nṛbhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Men who are well-disposed as friends and true to Law, even as the heavens in majesty surpass mankind.
paragraphs.original: मित्रासो न ये सुधिता ऋतायवो द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्ति मानुषान्
paragraphs.translit: mitrāso na ye sudhitā ṛtāyavo dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santi mānuṣān

paragraphs.text: 8. O Son of Strength, Victorious, with this title Upastuta's most potent voice reveres thee.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्जो नपात्सहसावन्निति त्वोपस्तुतस्य वन्दते वृषा वाक् ।
paragraphs.translit: ūrjo napātsahasāvanniti tvopastutasya vandate vṛṣā vāk |

paragraphs.text: Blest with brave sons by thee we will extol thee, and lengthen out the days of our existence.
paragraphs.original: त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः
paragraphs.translit: tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Thus, Agni, have the sons of Vrstihavya, the Rsis, the Upastutas invoked thee.
paragraphs.original: इति त्वाग्ने वृष्टिहव्यस्य पुत्रा उपस्तुतास ऋषयोऽवोचन् ।
paragraphs.translit: iti tvāgne vṛṣṭihavyasya putrā upastutāsa ṛṣayo'vocan |

paragraphs.text: Protect them, guard the singers and the princes. With Vasat! have they come, with hands uplifted, with their uplifted hands and cries of Glory!
paragraphs.original: ताँश्च पाहि गृणतश्च सूरीन्वषड्वषळित्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्नमो नम इत्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्
paragraphs.translit: tām̐śca pāhi gṛṇataśca sūrīnvaṣaḍvaṣaḷityūrdhvāso anakṣannamo nama ityūrdhvāso anakṣan
